scope: C30 local usability: cloned-checkout reference workflow, restart persistence and provider restore (N30)
c30_status: implemented and exercised on a shared development host; not verified because the clean-host run is outstanding
commands: KEYHELIX_CLONE_WORKTREE=1 KEYHELIX_REUSE_PROVIDERS=1 KEYHELIX_CLONE_RESTORE=1 npm run test:clone

results.engine: Go build, vet and all package tests pass; the composed runtime serves health, readiness, diagnostics, OIDC sign-in, session/step-up, metadata, write, reveal, grants and rotation routes.
results.web: 23 Node web/contract tests and 30 Playwright tests pass. Configuration now fails closed on engineEnabled=true, engine read endpoints reject non-GET methods, /readyz requires a composed core, and the vaults status filter reflects real metadata statuses.
results.C30: A cloned checkout ran npm run setup and the real browser workflow against OpenBao and Keycloak: readiness proved storage/provider/identity, owner sign-in, write version 1, reveal without step-up returned 401, step-up reveal returned the fixture sentinel with no-store, closing cleared the DOM, reopening demanded a fresh step-up, member listing was owner-scoped and member reveal returned 403, restart preserved metadata and reveal, the engine and provider data contained zero sentinel occurrences, and an OpenBao snapshot restore kept the secret readable.
results.limitation: The run used a working-tree snapshot and reused the shared host's provider containers, so it does not satisfy the clean-supported-host acceptance. Grant-revocation durability across restore is covered by C22 tests, not by this run.

next_recommended_task: C30 clean-host certification: committed clone, own providers, full C01-C30 evidence chain, then grant revocation across restore.
